label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee/celebration for the mayor, involving 200 fresh loaves on town-hall tables and lanterns, for the mayor's arrival at 18:00 on day 1. The innkeeper, baker, freight operator, and builder coordinated it; the builder installed lanterns and later hauled bread, freight sourced grain and hauled bread, and the innkeeper arranged lanterns and the mayor's appointment. The mayor was kept unaware of the celebratory purpose during preparations, though he was told of a routine civic-hospitality meeting and approved it.
